title: 00 · Your first EEG in MNE
goal: Inspect sampling, voltage units, channel names and event markers; understand the Raw → Epochs → Evoked workflow before starting the P300 track.
data: Controlled arrays and recorded EEGBCI subject 1, run 4

title: MNE-Python: scientific scope, software design and data model
goal: Review MNE capabilities, data representations, metadata, units, copying, event alignment and reproducible derivatives.
data: Controlled arrays and PhysioNet EEGBCI subject 1, run 4

title: 01 · P300 speller: from flashes to ERPs
goal: Load a real P300 speller recording, inspect target imbalance, visualize event-related activity and extract temporal features.
data: BNCI2014-009, subject 1, three sessions; MOABB → MNE

title: 02 · P300 classification and character selection
goal: Train a shrinkage LDA detector on real EEG, evaluate an unseen session, and implement row/column evidence accumulation with explicitly simulated flash metadata.
data: Real BNCI2014-009 target detection; separate labeled speller simulation

title: 03 · Filtering, sampling and spectral inspection
goal: Design and inspect EEG filters, distinguish offline and causal processing, and measure attenuation on real EEG.

title: 04 · Artifacts, referencing and noise cancellation
goal: Detect bad channels, compare reference choices, and understand regression and ICA through a controlled contamination experiment.
data: EEGBCI for QC/ICA; explicit controlled contamination for regression

title: 05 · Segmentation, baseline and quality control
goal: Build event-locked epochs from continuous EEG, audit discarded trials and preserve run identity.

title: 06 · Motor imagery: a first decoder
goal: Decode imagined left versus right hand movement with spectral features and leave-one-run-out validation.

title: 07 · Time–frequency analysis and ERD/ERS
goal: Compute wavelet power, normalize it to a pre-cue interval and interpret sensorimotor desynchronization.

title: 08 · BCI Competition IV 2a: CSP and LDA
goal: Use actual competition motor-imagery data, learn spatial filters inside training folds and evaluate transfer across sessions.

title: 09 · Honest validation and model selection
goal: Compare classifiers with nested run-grouped validation, distinguish uncertainty units and diagnose leakage.
data: EEGBCI subject 1, three independent run groups

title: 10 · SSVEP: spectral peaks and canonical correlation
goal: Decode 12 versus 15 Hz visual stimulation using spectral signal-to-noise ratio and a sinusoidal-reference CCA decoder.

title: 11 · Auditory and visual evoked responses
goal: Explore a different event-related paradigm, compare EEG responses to auditory and visual stimuli and distinguish sensory decoding from intentional BCI control.
data: MNE sample auditory/visual EEG; large optional download

title: 12 · Beyond EEG: fNIRS motor responses
goal: Convert optical intensity to hemoglobin changes and compare a slow hemodynamic paradigm with electrophysiological BCI.
data: Native MNE fNIRS motor dataset, participant 1

title: 13 · Neural networks and autoencoders for EEG
goal: Train a small temporal CNN and a denoising autoencoder using training-only normalization; compare what their losses actually measure.

title: 14 · From offline analysis to causal replay
goal: Process recorded EEG in chunks with persistent filter state and verify that chunking does not change the causal result.
data: Recorded EEGBCI stream; no live hardware

title: 15 · Capstone: a reproducible BCI experiment
goal: Complete a baseline experiment and produce an auditable result table, then extend one paradigm with a predeclared hypothesis.
